quote: In this paper, we propose Stepwise Correction (STEPCO), an iterative verify-then-revise framework for LLMs on reasoning tasks. [...] We evaluated STEPCO on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks and extended it to open-domain question answering and commonsense reasoning tasks.
